concept: ネオン以外を含む複数の方向性で、ComfyUI の出力品質が LLM 側（GenerateImage）に対してどれだけ落ちるかを見る
note: 品質ギャップの検証（pop）。LLM 側の探索セット 11 と同じセル指定の偶数番 12 件を ComfyUI で生成。参考列は LLM 側 24 枚全体の仕分け結果。

conditions.name: xl-11-pop
conditions.prompt_prefix: flat graphic decoration exploring pop art and playfulness, vivid colors, comic print, sticker texture, screen print, airbrush, graffiti, playful hand-drawn marks, full frame composition
conditions.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, people, face, photo, mockup, perspective grid floor, frame, border
conditions.reference: like 0 / dislike 23 / maybe 1（24 枚中 like 0%）

items.text: oversized comic speech bubble shapes with no words, explosive starbursts and halftone dots
1960s pop-art colorful cans with no labels or lettering
candy-colored pinball machine parts, bumpers and springs with no numbers
toy building blocks and wind-up toy shapes in bold primary colors
graffiti-style spray arcs, drips and arrows on concrete, no tags or letters
carnival prize ribbons, confetti and streamers without writing
retro television screens showing abstract color waves, no text
colorful yo-yos, bouncing balls and jump ropes without people
surreal melting checker-free clock shapes with no numbers
neon roller coaster tracks and stars without riders
1970s psychedelic wavy color bands and liquid forms
playful paper cut-out masks with abstract eye holes, no faces
